ev.q: The age-adjusted COVID-19 incidence was 26,583 per 100,000 persons among AI/AN persons compared with 11,935 among White persons (RR = 2.23)
COVID-19 incidence, hospitalization, and death rates, by race
Rate ratios for age-adjusted case, hospitalization, and mortality rates for AI/AN persons compared with White persons in 2020 and 2021 were 2.2, 2.7, and 2.9
Population proportions and age-adjusted COVID-19 case, hospitalization, and mortality rates were calculated to account for differences in underlying population age distributions.
a retrospective analysis of COVID-19 cases reported to the Alaska Department of Health and Social Services (AKDHSS) during March 12, 2020–December 31, 2021, was conducted

methods_quotes.q: Rates were calculated by age group and race, using the direct method standardized to the U.S. 2000 standard population
Corresponding 95% CIs were calculated based on the gamma distribution
Bivariate analyses used Fisher’s exact test given the lack of normality of the underlying data
RRs were calculated using age-adjusted rates, with White persons as the referent group; corresponding 95% CIs that excluded 1 were considered statistically significant.
a sensitivity analysis was performed by recalculating the RR, categorizing all those with unknown race as White persons.
